scope: Prepare a second exact-source test profile using the existing isolated execution policy; leave activation and live execution disabled.
riskAnalysis: New fixed guest recipe and report parser are security-sensitive even while disabled. Preserve legacy command bytes, exact source identity, all jail/resource/cleanup boundaries and explicit profile separation. No new paid or execution authority.

threatModel.assets: Source/task/release identity, historical execution receipts, credentials, isolation policy, permission separation and audit history.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Known fixed source pair vs untrusted future model patch; serialized guest vs trusted supervisor; synthetic report shape vs authenticated provider evidence; prepare-only metadata vs owner permission.
threatModel.abuseCases: Cross-profile/source/workspace results, forged qualification, arbitrary guest source/commands, legacy grant reuse, false cleanup/acceptance, secret log output.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact source and descriptor hashes, one canonical replacement, strict input keys, WeakMap prepared-job seal, separate fixed result contract, detached source metadata, no provider/dispatch interface, unchanged old authorization and resolved task denial.

defects.rootCause: Existing sandbox test recipe supports only exact Starter behavior; another bounded task cannot reuse a safe fixed test preparation contract.
defects.detectionGap: First sandbox milestone intentionally qualified one fixed task only.
defects.regression: Second exact hash pair, seven fixed guest checks; trusted fake-OS supervisor success/fail/cleanup, cross-profile/workspace/result tampering and byte-identical legacy commands.
defects.historicalPrevention: Version execution recipes rather than rewriting serialized historical commands. Require exact-profile OS qualification and fresh task permission before activation.

rollback: Revert only new prepared profile/capability on feature Preview; do not restore grants or alter old source/command receipts. Main and Production unchanged.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend fixed source-test preparation within existing engineering architecture; version recipe for immutable old command preservation. No new orchestrator/provider/journal.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, provider, credential or permission changes. Shared seccomp and current pinned image policy preserved.
proactiveReview.threats: Cross-profile/source/workspace results, forged qualification, arbitrary guest source/commands, legacy grant reuse, false cleanup/acceptance, secret log output.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Parser success cannot establish actual execution, qualification or acceptance. Failed cleanup/test/output must remain failure; resolved task stays closed.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Source/profile/workspace/command/test hashes and IDs; root failure, missing isolation/termination, output overflow, unsafe binary, unmount/cleanup failure. Guest source never evaluated by mocks.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent existing Work QA/Auditor reviewed prepare-only boundaries and no authority creation. Final delta and hosted review required.
proactiveReview.recovery: Leave existing Preview/Starter execution functional and old commands identical. Revert new profile only without rewriting prior receipts.
